entries.meaningZh: actinodont：齿呈辐射状排列的，古生物形态术语
entries.en: The fossil key describes the hinge as actinodont.
entries.zh: 化石检索表把铰合部描述为辐射齿型。

entries.meaningZh: actinogen：产生射线的物质，旧式用语
entries.en: The historical index uses actinogen for a radiation-producing substance.
entries.zh: 历史索引用actinogen指产生射线的物质。

entries.meaningZh: actinoleukin：放线菌白素，按原资料的化合物名
entries.en: The compound-name index lists actinoleukin on a separate line.
entries.zh: 化合物名称索引将放线菌白素单独列在一行。

entries.en: The museum displayed an actinolyte beside other obsolete medical instruments.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一台旧放射治疗器与其他过时医疗器具一起展出。

entries.en: The historical illustration labels the compact mass actinomycome.
entries.zh: 历史插图把这团致密结构标为放线菌块。

entries.meaningZh: actinone：放线菌酮的旧名，依原资料
entries.en: The old index cross-references actinone to cycloheximide.
entries.zh: 旧索引把actinone交叉指向放线菌酮。

entries.meaningZh: actinophor：历史钍铈造影制剂名称
entries.en: The radiology archive retains a label bearing the name actinophor.
entries.zh: 放射学档案保留着一张印有actinophor名称的标签。

entries.en: The historical medical glossary lists actinophytosis among older disease names.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表把actinophytosis列为旧病名。

entries.en: The anatomy plate labels the ray-supported fin actinopterygium.
entries.zh: 解剖图版把这种鳍条支撑的鳍标为辐鳍。

entries.meaningZh: actinospore：原资料中的放线菌孢子名称
entries.en: The old microbiology diagram uses the label actinospore.
entries.zh: 旧微生物学示意图使用了actinospore这一标签。

entries.en: The medical-history syllabus includes a section on actinotherapeutics.
entries.zh: 医学史教学大纲有一节介绍旧式放射治疗学。

entries.meaningZh: actinitis：原资料中与痤疮样结核疹有关的旧病名
entries.en: The editor checked the spelling of actinitis against the original case index.
entries.zh: 编辑对照原病例索引核对了actinitis的拼写。

entries.meaningZh: action figure：可动人偶；人物玩具模型
entries.en: The child posed the action figure beside a cardboard spaceship.
entries.zh: 孩子把可动人偶摆在纸板飞船旁。

entries.meaningZh: action-oriented：以行动为导向的；重视落实的
entries.en: The committee wanted an action-oriented plan with clear responsibilities.
entries.zh: 委员会希望有一份重视落实、责任明确的计划。

entries.meaningZh: actinochitin：旧资料中的放线菌细胞壁物质名
entries.en: The old microbiology text calls the wall material actinochitin.
entries.zh: 旧微生物学教材把细胞壁物质称为actinochitin。

entries.en: The history chapter includes a map of Actium.
entries.zh: 历史章节中有一张阿克提姆的地图。

entries.meaningZh: active area：有效面积；起作用的区域
entries.en: The specification distinguishes the active area from the total panel size.
entries.zh: 规格说明区分了有效面积与面板总尺寸。

entries.meaningZh: active treatment：积极治疗；与不干预等相对的处理
entries.en: The ethics discussion contrasts active treatment with observation alone.
entries.zh: 伦理讨论比较了积极治疗与仅作观察的情形。

entries.meaningZh: Activol：旧资料中的赤霉素制剂名称
entries.en: The agricultural archive includes an Activol product leaflet.
entries.zh: 农业档案中有一份Activol产品说明页。

entries.en: The historical chemical index gives actol as a name for silver lactate.
entries.zh: 历史化学索引把actol列为乳酸银的名称。

entries.meaningZh: Actos：含吡格列酮的药品商品名
entries.en: The pharmacy archive files the Actos leaflet under brand names.
entries.zh: 药学档案把Actos说明页归在商品名项下。

entries.meaningZh: ACTT：英国电影与电视技术人员协会的历史缩写
entries.en: The film archive preserves an ACTT membership card.
entries.zh: 电影档案保存着一张电影与电视技术人员协会会员卡。

entries.en: The Spanish exercise explains that actualmente means currently, not actually.
entries.zh: 西班牙语练习说明actualmente是目前的意思，而不是英语actually。

entries.en: The mineral collection contains a specimen of actinolite.
entries.zh: 矿物收藏中有一件阳起石标本。

entries.meaningZh: acuclosure：针压止血法的历史名称
entries.en: The history of surgery places acuclosure among older methods of haemostasis.
entries.zh: 外科史把针压止血法列为较早的止血方法。

entries.meaningZh: acufilopressure：针线压迫止血法的旧称
entries.en: The museum label uses the historical term acufilopressure.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签使用了针线压迫止血法这一历史术语。

entries.meaningZh: acumycin：针霉素，历史抗生素名称
entries.en: The pharmacology index lists acumycin among historical antibiotic names.
entries.zh: 药理学索引把针霉素列在历史抗生素名称中。

entries.en: The paper distinguishes acute-phase markers from its other measurements.
entries.zh: 论文把急性期标志物与其他测量项目区分开。

entries.meaningZh: acutiplantar：鸟跗部后缘尖锐的，旧形态术语
entries.en: The bird key uses acutiplantar to describe the form of the tarsus.
entries.zh: 鸟类检索表用acutiplantar描述跗部的形态。

entries.meaningZh: acutum：拉丁语acutus的中性形式，急性的或尖锐的
entries.en: The Latin adjective acutum agrees with a neuter noun in the exercise.
entries.zh: 练习中的拉丁形容词acutum与一个中性名词保持一致。

entries.meaningZh: ACWA：美国服装工人联合会的历史名称缩写
entries.en: The labour-history display includes an ACWA banner.
entries.zh: 劳工史展陈中有一面美国服装工人联合会的旗帜。

entries.en: The historical glossary cross-references acyanopsia to an inability to perceive blue.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把acyanopsia指向不能感知蓝色的情况。

entries.en: The nomenclature exercise groups each acyl-azo compound in a separate row.
entries.zh: 命名练习把每种酰基偶氮化合物分别列成一行。

entries.en: The reaction-name index lists acylolysis under cleavage processes.
entries.zh: 反应名称索引把酰基裂解列在裂解过程之下。

entries.en: The diagram contrasts an acystic form with an encysted form.
entries.zh: 示意图对比了无囊形态与形成包囊的形态。

entries.meaningZh: aczoiling：原资料中的电杆防腐处理名称，词形未确认
entries.en: The editor left aczoiling unchanged in the old maintenance record.
entries.zh: 编辑没有改动旧维护记录里的aczoiling。

entries.en: The spreadsheet add-in adds a new command to the toolbar.
entries.zh: 电子表格加载项在工具栏上增加了一条新命令。

entries.meaningZh: adhocracy：灵活、临时组建的组织形式
entries.en: The small studio worked as an adhocracy, forming teams for each new project.
entries.zh: 这家小工作室以灵活组织方式运作，为每个新项目组建团队。

entries.meaningZh: ADAC：模数及数模转换设备的原缩略标记
entries.en: The interface diagram labels the conversion unit ADAC.
entries.zh: 接口示意图把转换单元标为ADAC。

entries.en: The museum displayed an adze beside the carpenter's other tools.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一把锛与木匠的其他工具一起展出。

entries.en: The bulletin included an additional alert for the coastal area.
entries.zh: 通报另附了一条沿海地区的补充警报。

entries.en: The historical pathology index preserves the term adamantinocarcinoma.
entries.zh: 历史病理学索引保留了釉质癌这一旧术语。

entries.meaningZh: Adamawa：阿达马瓦，西非地区或相关语言名称
entries.en: The language map includes a label for Adamawa.
entries.zh: 语言地图上有一个阿达马瓦标签。

entries.en: The geology collection includes a polished sample of adamellite.
entries.zh: 地质收藏中有一件抛光的石英二长岩样品。

entries.meaningZh: Adamic：与亚当有关的；亚当时代的
entries.en: The theologian discusses the idea of an Adamic language.
entries.zh: 神学家讨论了亚当语言这一观念。

entries.meaningZh: Adamism：亚当派的宗教观念或习俗，历史用语
entries.en: The book discusses Adamism in a chapter on religious sects.
entries.zh: 书中在宗教教派一章讨论了亚当派的观念。

entries.meaningZh: adanale：旧节肢动物形态资料中的肛侧板名
entries.en: The anatomical plate labels the small lateral plate adanale.
entries.zh: 解剖图版把这块小侧板标为adanale。

entries.meaningZh: adapid：兔猴类的已灭绝灵长动物
entries.en: The fossil catalogue groups the adapid specimens together.
entries.zh: 化石目录把兔猴类标本编在一起。

entries.meaningZh: adapterization：原资料中与拾音设备适配有关的旧名
entries.en: The editor retained adapterization in the caption of the old audio diagram.
entries.zh: 编辑在旧音响示意图的说明中保留了adapterization。

entries.en: The astronomy exhibit explains how adaptive optics improves telescope images.
entries.zh: 天文学展览解释了自适应光学如何改善望远镜图像。

entries.meaningZh: adarces：石灰华或钙华的旧名称
entries.en: The old geological catalogue labels the pale deposit adarces.
entries.zh: 旧地质目录把这种浅色沉积物标为石灰华。

entries.meaningZh: ADAS：英国农业发展与咨询服务机构名称
entries.en: The archive contains an ADAS advisory leaflet for farmers.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份农业发展与咨询服务机构为农民编写的咨询说明页。

entries.meaningZh: ADBT：存取判定汇集时间的原缩略标记
entries.en: The timing table includes a column labelled ADBT.
entries.zh: 时序表中有一栏标为ADBT。

entries.en: The newspaper devoted an ad column to local businesses.
entries.zh: 报纸用一个广告栏刊登本地商家的广告。

entries.en: The rock description identifies the sample as an adcumulate.
entries.zh: 岩石描述把该样品鉴定为补堆积岩。

entries.en: The assistant helped add up the day's receipts.
entries.zh: 助手帮忙合计了当天的收款。

entries.meaningZh: addaverter：旧电子技术资料中的加法转换器名称
entries.en: The old circuit diagram labels the unit addaverter.
entries.zh: 旧电路图把该单元标为加法转换器。

entries.meaningZh: added value：附加值；增加的价值
entries.en: The service offers little added value for the extra cost.
entries.zh: 这项服务虽然额外收费，却没有带来多少附加价值。

entries.en: The packet layout marks the address field ADDF.
entries.zh: 数据包布局图用ADDF标记地址字段。

entries.meaningZh: addictologist：研究成瘾问题的专业人员
entries.en: The conference programme included a talk by an addictologist.
entries.zh: 会议日程中有一场成瘾研究专业人员的报告。

entries.meaningZh: addigital：与指部或指羽相连的旧形态术语
entries.en: The old bird diagram uses addigital beside the wing feathers.
entries.zh: 旧鸟类示意图在翼羽旁使用了addigital这一标签。

entries.meaningZh: addisonism：类似阿狄森病表现的旧名称
entries.en: The medical historian distinguishes addisonism from the modern diagnostic label.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把addisonism这一旧名与现代诊断名称区分开。

entries.en: The clerk checked the total with an adding machine.
entries.zh: 职员用加算器核对了总数。

entries.meaningZh: addorsal：朝向背部的，旧解剖方向词
entries.en: The glossary contrasts an addorsal direction with movement towards the front.
entries.zh: 词汇表把朝向背部的方向与向前的运动作了对比。

entries.en: The timing diagram marks the address-enable signal above the data line.
entries.zh: 时序图在数据线之上标出了地址使能信号。

entries.en: The entomology key identifies the pupa as adecticous.
entries.zh: 昆虫学检索表将这只蛹归为颚不能活动的类型。

entries.en: The drug-name index lists adefovir alphabetically.
entries.zh: 药物名称索引按字母顺序列出阿德福韦。

entries.meaningZh: adeloceratous：触角隐蔽的，昆虫形态词
entries.en: The entomology glossary explains adeloceratous as having concealed antennae.
entries.zh: 昆虫学词汇表把adeloceratous解释为触角隐蔽的。

entries.meaningZh: adelomorphic：形态不明显的，旧组织学词
entries.en: The old caption calls the indistinctly outlined cells adelomorphic.
entries.zh: 旧图注把轮廓不清晰的细胞称为adelomorphic。

entries.meaningZh: adelphogamy：亲缘细胞之间的结合，旧生物学术语
entries.en: The diagram illustrates adelphogamy between related cells.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了亲缘细胞之间的结合。

entries.meaningZh: adelphotaxis：游走细胞的排列或定位，旧术语
entries.en: The diagram labels the arrangement of the motile cells adelphotaxis.
entries.zh: 示意图把游走细胞的排列标为adelphotaxis。

entries.en: The historical glossary places ademonia among terms for mental distress.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把ademonia列在精神困扰相关用语之中。

entries.en: The index places adenantherine among the plant alkaloid names.
entries.zh: 索引把海红豆碱列在植物生物碱名称中。

entries.en: The pathology vocabulary list includes adenectopia.
entries.zh: 病理学词汇表中列有腺异位。

entries.en: The historical genetics glossary explains the adjective adenineless.
entries.zh: 历史遗传学词汇表解释了缺乏腺嘌呤的这一形容词。

entries.meaningZh: adenocarcinomatous：腺癌的；具有腺癌特征的
entries.en: The pathology terminology exercise pairs adenocarcinomatous with adenocarcinoma.
entries.zh: 病理学术语练习把形容词腺癌的与名词腺癌配对。

entries.en: The chemical index distinguishes adrenochrome from adrenaline.
entries.zh: 化学索引区分了肾上腺素红与肾上腺素。

entries.en: The glossary explains the two-word modifier adenoid cystic.
entries.zh: 词汇表解释了腺样囊性的这一双词修饰语。

entries.en: The medical index gives adenomatosis its own entry.
entries.zh: 医学索引为腺瘤病设有独立条目。

entries.en: The lecture notes distinguish adenomyoma from similarly named conditions.
entries.zh: 讲义把腺肌瘤与名称相近的病变区分开。

entries.en: The historical case heading uses adenopharyngitis.
entries.zh: 历史病例标题使用了咽扁桃体炎这一旧名。

entries.en: The textbook index cross-references adenosarcoma to the relevant chapter.
entries.zh: 教材索引将腺肉瘤交叉指向相关章节。

entries.en: The nomenclature chart distinguishes adenosyl from adenyl.
entries.zh: 命名图表区分了腺苷基与腺嘌呤基。

entries.meaningZh: adenyl：腺嘌呤基，化学基团名称
entries.en: The glossary gives adenyl a separate entry from adenosyl.
entries.zh: 词汇表将腺嘌呤基与腺苷基分列条目。

entries.meaningZh: adenylylating：使发生腺苷酰化作用的，adenylylate的现在分词
entries.en: The terminology table pairs adenylylating with the noun adenylylation.
entries.zh: 术语表把adenylylating与名词腺苷酰化配对。

entries.en: The old insect catalogue describes the beetle as an adephage.
entries.zh: 旧昆虫目录将这只甲虫描述为肉食性甲虫。

entries.meaningZh: more adept：更加熟练的；adepter为罕见比较形式
entries.en: With practice, she became more adept at repairing small objects.
entries.zh: 随着练习增多，她更擅长修理小物件了。

entries.en: The room was small but adequate for our needs.
entries.zh: 房间虽小，但足以满足我们的需要。

entries.meaningZh: adermata：原资料中指透蛹的旧术语
entries.en: The entomology editor kept adermata in the transcription of the old key.
entries.zh: 昆虫学编辑转录旧检索表时保留了adermata。

entries.en: The historical medical index lists adesmosis under connective-tissue terms.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引把adesmosis列在结缔组织相关用语中。

entries.meaningZh: adieu：再见，较正式或文学的告别语
entries.en: She waved a quiet adieu from the carriage window.
entries.zh: 她从车厢窗边轻轻挥手告别。

entries.en: The exhibition included an ADFA course brochure.
entries.zh: 展览中有一份澳大利亚国防学院课程手册。

entries.meaningZh: adfrontal：额部旁侧的，昆虫形态词
entries.en: The insect diagram labels the adfrontal area beside the frons.
entries.zh: 昆虫示意图在额区旁标出了旁额区。

entries.en: The old description says the coating lies adherently on the surface.
entries.zh: 旧描述说，这层涂层黏附在表面上。

entries.meaningZh: adheroscope：旧资料中的黏附测定器具名
entries.en: The instrument inventory includes an adheroscope.
entries.zh: 仪器清单中有一台黏附测定器。

entries.en: The second tape was more adhesive than the first.
entries.zh: 第二种胶带比第一种黏性更强。

entries.meaningZh: ad hoc：为特定目的临时安排的
entries.en: They formed an ad hoc committee to organise the celebration.
entries.zh: 他们成立了一个临时委员会筹办庆典。

entries.meaningZh: adiabatics：绝热曲线；相关热力学研究的旧用法
entries.en: The old thermodynamics chart labels the curves adiabatics.
entries.zh: 旧热力学图把这些曲线标为绝热曲线。

entries.meaningZh: adiagnostic：不足以明确诊断或辨认的，旧技术用语
entries.en: The old description calls the fragment adiagnostic because its structure is unclear.
entries.zh: 旧描述因结构不清而称这个碎片不足以辨认。

entries.meaningZh: adiaphoria：无反应；对刺激不反应的旧术语
entries.en: The historical glossary defines adiaphoria without assigning a modern diagnosis.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表解释了无反应这一旧术语，但没有赋予它现代诊断名称。

entries.meaningZh: adiathermance：不透热性；阻止热辐射通过的性质
entries.en: The old physics glossary contrasts adiathermance with transparency to heat radiation.
entries.zh: 旧物理学词汇表对比了不透热性与对热辐射的透过性。

entries.en: The drug-name index cross-references adiazine to sulfadiazine.
entries.zh: 药名索引把adiazine交叉指向磺胺嘧啶。

entries.meaningZh: adigar：斯里兰卡历史官员称号
entries.en: The historian explains the title adigar in a chapter on the royal court.
entries.zh: 历史学家在王室一章中解释了阿迪加尔这一官衔。

entries.en: The numerical-analysis lecture introduced ADIM after the simpler difference scheme.
entries.zh: 数值分析课在较简单的差分格式之后介绍了交替方向隐式法。

entries.meaningZh: ADIO：模数输入输出的缩略标记
entries.en: The interface diagram labels the input-output block ADIO.
entries.zh: 接口示意图把输入输出模块标为ADIO。

entries.en: The historical chemical index lists adipinketone as an older name for cyclopentanone.
entries.zh: 历史化学索引把adipinketone列为环戊酮的旧名。

entries.en: The medical terminology exercise pairs adipofibroma with its plural form.
entries.zh: 医学术语练习把脂肪纤维瘤的单数与复数形式配对。

entries.en: The pathology glossary gives adiponecrosis a plain-language explanation.
entries.zh: 病理学词汇表用通俗语言解释了脂肪坏死。

entries.en: The project diagram places ADIS between the two data centres.
entries.zh: 项目示意图把自动数据交换系统放在两个数据中心之间。

entries.en: The map legend explains the abbreviation ADIZ.
entries.zh: 地图图例解释了防空识别区这一缩写。

entries.en: The graph stores adjacency information in a matrix.
entries.zh: 这个图用矩阵存储邻接信息。

entries.meaningZh: adjectively：作形容词地；具有形容词作用地
entries.en: In that phrase, stone is used adjectively.
entries.zh: 在那个短语中，stone作形容词使用。

entries.meaningZh: adjoiner：邻接者；相邻的部分，较罕见用语
entries.en: The old property description calls the neighbouring owner an adjoiner.
entries.zh: 旧房产描述把相邻业主称为adjoiner。

entries.en: The exercise asks students to find the adjugate of a square matrix.
entries.zh: 练习要求学生求一个方阵的伴随矩阵。

entries.meaningZh: adjustage：精整或校准设备的旧称
entries.en: The factory inventory groups the adjustage with other finishing equipment.
entries.zh: 工厂清单把精整设备与其他后处理设备归在一起。

entries.meaningZh: adjuvance：帮助；辅助作用，罕见用语
entries.en: The old text acknowledges the adjuvance of several colleagues.
entries.zh: 旧文感谢几位同事给予的帮助。

entries.en: The social-care report uses ADL as a heading for everyday activities.
entries.zh: 社会照护报告用ADL作为日常活动一栏的标题。

entries.meaningZh: adlection：正式增补或选入组织，历史用语
entries.en: The history chapter describes his adlection to the senate.
entries.zh: 历史章节描述了他被增补进入元老院的经过。

entries.meaningZh: ADLM：原资料中的财务数据表格管理标记
entries.en: The old software catalogue has an entry headed ADLM.
entries.zh: 旧软件目录有一个以ADLM为标题的条目。

entries.meaningZh: adlumidine：紫罂粟次碱，植物生物碱名称
entries.en: The chemical-name index lists adlumidine beside related plant compounds.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引把紫罂粟次碱与相关植物化合物并列。

entries.en: The systems chapter uses ADM for automated data management.
entries.zh: 系统章节用ADM表示自动数据管理。

entries.meaningZh: adminicula：拉丁语支撑物、辅助物的复数形式
entries.en: The Latin glossary explains adminicula as supports or aids.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表把adminicula解释为支撑物或辅助物。

entries.meaningZh: administrador：西班牙语或葡萄牙语的管理员
entries.en: The bilingual notice gives administrador as the title of the building manager.
entries.zh: 双语通知把楼宇管理员的职衔写作administrador。

entries.meaningZh: admiralcy：海军上将的职位或职权
entries.en: The biography discusses his appointment to the admiralcy.
entries.zh: 传记讨论了他获任海军上将的经过。

entries.en: The gallery advertised an admission-free evening opening.
entries.zh: 画廊宣传了一场免门票的晚间开放活动。

entries.en: A slight admixture of blue gave the paint a cooler tone.
entries.zh: 掺入少量蓝色让涂料的色调更冷。

entries.en: She heard soft murmuring in the hall.
entries.zh: 她听见大厅里轻轻的低语声。

entries.meaningZh: Adnephrin：历史肾上腺素制剂名称
entries.en: The pharmacy archive holds an Adnephrin label.
entries.zh: 药学档案中保存着一张Adnephrin标签。

entries.meaningZh: adnexa uteri：子宫附件，拉丁解剖短语
entries.en: The anatomical index lists adnexa uteri as a separate heading.
entries.zh: 解剖学索引把子宫附件列为单独标题。

entries.meaningZh: adnexitis：附件炎，尤指子宫附件炎
entries.en: The medical glossary distinguishes adnexitis from other similarly named conditions.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表区分了附件炎与名称相近的其他病变。

entries.meaningZh: adnexorganogenic：源于子宫附件的，旧医学用语
entries.en: The historical glossary explains adnexorganogenic as an adjective of origin.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把adnexorganogenic解释为表示来源的形容词。

entries.en: Without further ado, she opened the meeting.
entries.zh: 她不再耽搁，直接宣布会议开始。

entries.en: Adona brought a folded map for the walk.
entries.zh: 阿多娜带来了一张折叠地图供徒步时使用。

entries.meaningZh: adonidin：阿多尼丁，侧金盏花相关混合苷的旧名
entries.en: The historical index lists adonidin under plant-glycoside names.
entries.zh: 历史索引把adonidin列在植物苷类名称中。

entries.meaningZh: adonilide：侧金盏花内酮，依原资料名称
entries.en: The compound index distinguishes adonilide from similarly named entries.
entries.zh: 化合物索引把侧金盏花内酮与名称相近的条目区分开。

entries.en: The nomenclature chart cross-references adonitol to ribitol.
entries.zh: 命名图表把adonitol交叉指向核糖醇。

entries.en: The historical toxicology index includes adonitoxin.
entries.zh: 历史毒理学索引中列有侧金盏花毒苷。

entries.en: The anatomical diagram labels the adorbital region beside the eye socket.
entries.zh: 解剖示意图在眼眶旁标出了近眶区。

entries.meaningZh: ADPACS：自动数据处理和通信服务
entries.en: The old systems directory lists ADPACS as a service heading.
entries.zh: 旧系统目录把自动数据处理和通信服务列为服务标题。

entries.meaningZh: adquisitiones：拉丁法律资料中与取得方式有关的复数形式
entries.en: The legal historian retained adquisitiones in the transcription.
entries.zh: 法律史研究者在转录中保留了adquisitiones。

entries.meaningZh: adradius：从辐，辐射对称动物中的辐向名称
entries.en: The zoological plate marks an adradius between the other labelled radii.
entries.zh: 动物学图版在其他已标注辐向之间标出了一条从辐。

entries.meaningZh: additional rate：附加税率或附加费率
entries.en: The bill shows the additional rate on a separate line.
entries.zh: 账单在单独一行列出了附加费率。

entries.meaningZh: adrenocorticoids：肾上腺皮质激素的复数名称
entries.en: The physiology textbook groups adrenocorticoids in a separate section.
entries.zh: 生理学教材把肾上腺皮质激素列在单独一节中。

entries.en: The historical glossary defines adrenogenous as indicating adrenal origin.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把adrenogenous解释为表示肾上腺来源。

entries.meaningZh: adrenolutine：肾上腺黄素，旧化学名称
entries.en: The pigment index lists adrenolutine separately from adrenochrome.
entries.zh: 色素索引把肾上腺黄素与肾上腺素红分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: adrenotrophic：促肾上腺的；对肾上腺有营养作用的
entries.en: The endocrine glossary contrasts adrenotrophic with a term describing adrenal origin.
entries.zh: 内分泌词汇表把促肾上腺的与描述肾上腺来源的术语作了对照。

entries.en: Adriana saved the empty jars for storing buttons.
entries.zh: 阿德里亚娜留下空罐子存放纽扣。

entries.meaningZh: ADRIS：原资料中的犬红细胞免疫血清标记
entries.en: The historical serum catalogue includes an entry marked ADRIS.
entries.zh: 历史血清目录中有一项标为ADRIS。

entries.en: The bird diagram labels a small adrostral area.
entries.zh: 鸟类示意图标出了一处小的近喙区。

entries.meaningZh: Adsee：原资料中的助剂商品名
entries.en: The old materials catalogue prints Adsee in the trade-name column.
entries.zh: 旧材料目录把Adsee印在商品名一栏。

entries.en: The old router supported an ADSL connection.
entries.zh: 这台旧路由器支持非对称数字用户线路连接。

entries.en: The materials report compares the adsorbency of the two surfaces.
entries.zh: 材料报告比较了两种表面的吸附性。

entries.meaningZh: adsperse：密布小点的，旧形态描述词
entries.en: The old specimen description calls the dotted surface adsperse.
entries.zh: 旧标本描述把布满小点的表面称为adsperse。

entries.meaningZh: adstrictio：拉丁旧术语中的抑制或收紧
entries.en: The Latin glossary gives adstrictio a brief explanation.
entries.zh: 拉丁语词汇表对adstrictio作了简短解释。

entries.meaningZh: Adtervac：原资料中的干血浆处理方法名称
entries.en: The history-of-medicine index preserves the name Adtervac.
entries.zh: 医学史索引保留了Adtervac这一名称。

entries.en: The old ophthalmology diagram labels the inward rotation adtorsion.
entries.zh: 旧眼科学示意图把向内旋转标为adtorsion。

entries.en: The audience stayed quiet during the final movement.
entries.zh: 观众在最后一个乐章中保持安静。

entries.en: The geological glossary includes adularization among alteration processes.
entries.zh: 地质词汇表把冰长石化列在蚀变作用中。

entries.meaningZh: adult entertainment：成人娱乐，常指色情娱乐
entries.en: The article examines how adult entertainment is classified in media regulation.
entries.zh: 文章研究了成人娱乐在媒体监管中的分类。

entries.en: The medical terminology lesson explains the modifier adult-onset.
entries.zh: 医学术语课解释了成年后起病的这一修饰语。

entries.meaningZh: adulterant：掺入以降低纯度的物质
entries.en: The inspection report identified a cheaper oil as an adulterant.
entries.zh: 检验报告把一种较便宜的油认定为掺杂物。

entries.meaningZh: adumbrant：预示的；隐约显出轮廓的
entries.en: The critic found the early sketch adumbrant of the artist's later style.
entries.zh: 评论者认为，这幅早期草图隐约预示了艺术家后来的风格。

entries.en: The photography archive lists adurol among old developer names.
entries.zh: 摄影档案把adurol列在旧显影剂名称中。

entries.meaningZh: adustiosis：原资料中与灼热损伤有关的旧病名
entries.en: The historical glossary groups adustiosis with heat-related terms.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把adustiosis与热损伤相关术语编在一起。

entries.en: The contract lists the advance fee separately from the final payment.
entries.zh: 合同把预付费用与尾款分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: advanced degree：高等学位，通常指研究生学位
entries.en: The job advertisement asks for an advanced degree in a related subject.
entries.zh: 招聘广告要求具备相关学科的研究生学位。

entries.meaningZh: Advanced Placement：美国大学先修课程与考试项目名称
entries.en: Her school offers Advanced Placement courses in calculus and biology.
entries.zh: 她的学校开设微积分和生物学的大学先修课程。

entries.en: Living near the station gave them a clear advantage.
entries.zh: 住在车站附近给他们带来了明显的便利。

entries.en: The magazine has a section devoted to adventure travel.
entries.zh: 杂志有一个专门介绍探险旅游的栏目。

entries.en: The final phrase has an adverbial function.
entries.zh: 最后一个短语起状语作用。

entries.en: The report lists each adverse event without assigning a cause.
entries.zh: 报告列出了每项不良事件，但没有确定其原因。

entries.en: The museum hired an advertising agency to promote the exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆聘请了一家广告代理公司宣传展览。

entries.en: The shop relies on word of mouth rather than paid advertising.
entries.zh: 这家店依靠口碑，而不是付费广告。

entries.en: The chair took the proposal under advisement.
entries.zh: 主席表示将考虑这项提案。

entries.en: The adviser suggested a simpler way to organise the material.
entries.zh: 顾问建议采用更简单的方式整理材料。

entries.meaningZh: advocacy：倡导；支持某种主张的活动
entries.en: Her advocacy helped keep the local library open.
entries.zh: 她的倡导帮助当地图书馆继续开放。

entries.meaningZh: Adweek：广告周刊，媒体刊物名称
entries.en: The library keeps recent issues of Adweek near the business journals.
entries.zh: 图书馆把较新的《广告周刊》放在商业期刊附近。

entries.meaningZh: adyta：adytum的复数，神殿内殿或圣所
entries.en: The plan marks the inner sanctuaries as adyta.
entries.zh: 平面图把内殿标为adyta。

entries.en: The chemical index distinguishes adynerin from other similarly named glycosides.
entries.zh: 化学索引把adynerin与名称相近的其他苷类区分开。

entries.meaningZh: AECC：航空医疗转运调度中心
entries.en: The historical organisation chart includes an AECC.
entries.zh: 历史组织结构图中有一个航空医疗转运调度中心。

entries.en: The fungal illustration labels the aecidospore stage.
entries.zh: 真菌插图标出了锈孢子阶段。

entries.en: The bibliography includes an AECT conference volume.
entries.zh: 参考文献中有一册教育传播与技术协会会议论文集。

entries.en: The mineral catalogue cross-references aedelforsite to wollastonite.
entries.zh: 矿物目录把aedelforsite交叉指向硅灰石。

entries.meaningZh: aedoeauxe：生殖器肥大的旧医学名称
entries.en: The historical medical index retains the heading aedoeauxe.
entries.zh: 历史医学索引保留了aedoeauxe这一标题。

entries.en: The engineering report describes the AEDS used for the drawings.
entries.zh: 工程报告描述了用于绘图的自动化工程设计系统。

entries.en: The old glossary pairs acetonemic with the noun acetonemia.
entries.zh: 旧词汇表把形容词acetonemic与名词丙酮血症配对。

entries.meaningZh: aegagrus：野山羊学名中的种加词
entries.en: The field guide gives the wild goat's name as Capra aegagrus.
entries.zh: 野外指南将野山羊的学名写作Capra aegagrus。

entries.en: The botanical index places Aegilops near other grass genera.
entries.zh: 植物学索引把山羊草属与其他禾草属编在邻近位置。

entries.meaningZh: aegithognathism：雀腭型的鸟类腭部结构
entries.en: The comparative-anatomy chapter uses aegithognathism for a form of the bird palate.
entries.zh: 比较解剖学章节用aegithognathism指鸟类的一种腭部结构。

entries.meaningZh: aeipathia：长期疾病或痼疾的旧称
entries.en: The historical glossary describes aeipathia as prolonged illness.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把aeipathia解释为长期疾病。

entries.meaningZh: Aello：阿伊洛，希腊神话中的名字
entries.en: The glossary lists Aello among names from Greek mythology.
entries.zh: 词汇表把阿伊洛列在希腊神话名字中。

entries.meaningZh: AELR：All England Law Reports，《全英格兰法律报告》的缩写
entries.en: The footnote gives an AELR reference for the case.
entries.zh: 脚注为这起案件提供了《全英格兰法律报告》的文献标注。

entries.en: The essay uses aelurophilia to describe the writer's lifelong love of cats.
entries.zh: 文章用aelurophilia描述这位作者一生对猫的喜爱。

entries.meaningZh: AEN：急性表皮坏死松解的旧缩写
entries.en: The historical glossary expands AEN as acute epidermal necrolysis.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把AEN展开为急性表皮坏死松解。

entries.en: An aeolid moved slowly across the rock in the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片中，一只蓑海牛缓慢地爬过岩石。

entries.meaningZh: aeolosphere：各向异性球，旧光学用语
entries.en: The optics notes use aeolosphere for an anisotropic sphere.
entries.zh: 光学笔记用aeolosphere指各向异性球。

entries.en: The old networking manual includes a section on AEP.
entries.zh: 旧网络手册有一节介绍AppleTalk回显协议。

entries.meaningZh: depression：抑郁或低落状态；本句选情绪低落义
entries.en: The letter describes a period of deep depression after the loss.
entries.zh: 信中描述了丧失亲人后的一段深深低落的时期。

entries.meaningZh: aequalis：拉丁语的相等的、均匀的
entries.en: The Latin exercise pairs aequalis with its English equivalent equal.
entries.zh: 拉丁语练习把aequalis与相应的英语equal配对。

entries.meaningZh: aequum：拉丁语中公平或相等的事物，见于ex aequo等相关形式
entries.en: The Latin commentary uses aequum when discussing fairness.
entries.zh: 拉丁语评注在讨论公平时使用了aequum。

entries.en: The agricultural-history chapter describes the growth of aeroagronomy.
entries.zh: 农业史章节描述了航空农业的发展。

entries.en: The diagram marks the aeration zone above the water table.
entries.zh: 示意图在地下水位以上标出了通气带。

entries.en: The old aerodrome is shown on the historical map.
entries.zh: 历史地图上标出了那座旧机场。

entries.en: The historical glossary describes aerenterectasia as gaseous distension of the bowel.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把aerenterectasia解释为肠道气体膨胀。

entries.en: The photograph shows an aviator beside an early aircraft.
entries.zh: 照片中，一名飞行员站在一架早期飞机旁。

entries.meaningZh: airiest：最通风的；最轻盈的，airy的最高级
entries.en: They chose the airiest room in the house.
entries.zh: 他们选了屋里最通风的房间。

entries.meaningZh: aeriscope：旧电视技术资料中的摄像管名称
entries.en: The television-history catalogue contains a diagram of an aeriscope.
entries.zh: 电视技术史目录中有一幅aeriscope摄像管示意图。

entries.en: The medical-history index cross-references aeroembolism to gas embolism.
entries.zh: 医学史索引把aeroembolism交叉指向气体栓塞。

entries.meaningZh: aerodontalgia：气压变化相关牙痛的术语
entries.en: The aviation-medicine glossary includes aerodontalgia.
entries.zh: 航空医学词汇表列有气压性牙痛。

entries.en: She wanted a career in aerospace rather than car manufacturing.
entries.zh: 她想在航空航天领域工作，而不是汽车制造业。

entries.meaningZh: aeroaspiration：空气吸入的旧技术名称
entries.en: The old instrument manual uses aeroaspiration as a descriptive heading.
entries.zh: 旧仪器手册用空气吸入作为描述性标题。

entries.en: The historical microbiology chart separates aerobacteria from anaerobic forms.
entries.zh: 历史微生物学图表把需氧细菌与厌氧类型分开。

entries.en: The biology glossary contrasts an aerobiont with an anaerobiont.
entries.zh: 生物学词汇表对比了需氧生物与厌氧生物。

entries.en: The archive photograph shows an aeroboat resting on calm water.
entries.zh: 档案照片中，一架水上飞机停在平静水面上。

entries.meaningZh: aerobus：旧资料中的载客飞机名称
entries.en: The transport-history poster includes a drawing labelled aerobus.
entries.zh: 交通史海报中有一幅标为aerobus的图。

entries.en: The mapping course introduces aerocartography through historical photographs.
entries.zh: 制图课程通过历史照片介绍航空制图。

entries.en: The navigator's archive contains a folded aerochart.
entries.zh: 领航员的档案里有一张折叠航空图。

entries.meaningZh: aerochlorination：压气氯化法的旧工艺名
entries.en: The water-treatment history includes the term aerochlorination.
entries.zh: 水处理史中出现了压气氯化法这一术语。

entries.en: The library catalogues aeroclimatology under atmospheric science.
entries.zh: 图书馆把高空气候学编在大气科学类。

entries.en: The building sample board includes a block of aeroconcrete.
entries.zh: 建筑材料样板上有一块加气混凝土。

entries.meaningZh: aerocurve：曲翼或曲翼飞机的旧称
entries.en: The patent sketch shows the aerocurve above the fuselage.
entries.zh: 专利草图把曲翼画在机身上方。

entries.en: The plant illustration labels the small air-filled structure an aerocyst.
entries.zh: 植物插图把这个充气的小结构标为气囊。

entries.en: The dental glossary explains aerodentalgia in a section on pressure changes.
entries.zh: 牙科学词汇表在气压变化一节中解释了气压性牙痛。

entries.meaningZh: Aerodist：航空微波测距设备名称
entries.en: The surveying archive includes an Aerodist instrument manual.
entries.zh: 测绘档案中有一本Aerodist航空测距仪手册。

entries.en: The old syllabus lists aerodromics beside flight mechanics.
entries.zh: 旧教学大纲把滑翔力学与飞行力学并列。

entries.en: The museum catalogue places the aeroductor among obsolete obstetric instruments.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录把aeroductor列在过时的产科器械中。

entries.en: The engineering bibliography lists an early book on aeroelastics.
entries.zh: 工程学书目列出了一本早期气动弹性学著作。

entries.meaningZh: aerofilter：空气过滤器或曝气滤池的旧名称
entries.en: The old plant diagram labels the aerofilter beside the other treatment units.
entries.zh: 旧设施示意图把曝气滤池标在其他处理单元旁。

entries.meaningZh: aerofluxus：排气的旧医学拉丁语名称
entries.en: The historical glossary gives aerofluxus as a term for the passage of gas.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把aerofluxus列为排气的术语。

entries.en: The crew list uses aerogator for the navigator's role.
entries.zh: 机组名单用aerogator表示领航员的职务。

entries.en: The chapter separates aerogenesis from the later movement of the gas.
entries.zh: 这一章区分了气体生成与其后的气体移动。

entries.meaningZh: aeroglycan：原资料中的糖类物质名称
entries.en: The carbohydrate index prints aeroglycan beside its reference number.
entries.zh: 糖类索引在参考编号旁印出了aeroglycan。

entries.meaningZh: aerogun：航空机关枪或航空炮的旧称
entries.en: The aviation museum displayed an aerogun with a historical caption.
entries.zh: 航空博物馆展出了一件航空机枪，并附有历史说明。

entries.meaningZh: aerohydrodynamics：空气及液体流动相关动力学
entries.en: The course places aerohydrodynamics between its sections on air and water flow.
entries.zh: 课程把空气液体动力学安排在空气流动与水流两节之间。

entries.en: The instrument list includes an aerohypsometer.
entries.zh: 仪器清单中有一台高空测高计。

entries.meaningZh: aeroionotherapy：空气离子疗法的历史名称
entries.en: The medical historian discusses aeroionotherapy as a historical practice.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把空气离子疗法作为历史做法讨论。

entries.meaningZh: aeroklinoscope：原资料词形，具体器物或结构身份未确认
entries.en: The curator placed a question mark beside the label aeroklinoscope.
entries.zh: 馆员在aeroklinoscope这个标签旁打了一个问号。

entries.en: The museum arranged the aerolites in order of weight.
entries.zh: 博物馆把陨石按重量排列。

entries.en: The navigation-history index includes aerolongation.
entries.zh: 航行史索引列有等压面领航这一旧名。

entries.en: His aeromania filled the house with model aircraft.
entries.zh: 他对航空的狂热使屋里摆满了飞机模型。

entries.en: She kept an Aeroméxico boarding pass in her travel journal.
entries.zh: 她在旅行日记中留着一张墨西哥航空公司的登机牌。

entries.en: The transport catalogue includes a drawing of an aeromobile.
entries.zh: 交通工具目录中有一幅气垫车图。

entries.meaningZh: aéronautique：法语的航空的或航空学的
entries.en: The French course brochure uses aéronautique in the department title.
entries.zh: 法语课程宣传册在系名中使用了表示航空的aéronautique。

entries.en: The older enzyme glossary uses aerooxidase as a descriptive name.
entries.zh: 较早的酶学词汇表使用aerooxidase作为描述性名称。

entries.en: The historical glossary cross-references aeroperitoneum to pneumoperitoneum.
entries.zh: 历史词汇表把aeroperitoneum交叉指向腹腔积气。

entries.meaningZh: aerophilous：喜气生或适于空气环境的
entries.en: The ecology glossary contrasts aerophilous with terms for water-loving organisms.
entries.zh: 生态学词汇表把喜空气环境的与喜水生物相关术语作了对比。

entries.en: The historical medical display includes a label for oxygen inhalation.
entries.zh: 医学史展陈中有一块写着氧气吸入的标签。

entries.en: The surveying textbook introduces aerophotogrammetry with a pair of aerial images.
entries.zh: 测量学教材用一对航拍图像介绍航空摄影测量。

entries.meaningZh: aerophytobiont：原资料中的好气土壤微生物旧描述名
entries.en: The soil-ecology index lists aerophytobiont as an older descriptive term.
entries.zh: 土壤生态学索引把aerophytobiont列为较旧的描述性术语。

entries.meaningZh: aeroplethysmography：呼吸气量描记法的旧名称
entries.en: The physiology-history chapter includes a diagram labelled aeroplethysmography.
entries.zh: 生理学史章节有一幅标为呼吸气量描记法的示意图。

entries.meaningZh: aeroporotomy：呼吸道通气手术的历史名称
entries.en: The surgical-history index preserves the term aeroporotomy.
entries.zh: 外科史索引保留了aeroporotomy这一术语。

entries.meaningZh: aeropulse：脉动喷气发动机的旧称
entries.en: The aviation catalogue includes a cutaway drawing of an aeropulse.
entries.zh: 航空目录中有一幅脉动喷气发动机的剖面图。

entries.en: The terminal plan labels the boarding platform aeroquay.
entries.zh: 航站楼平面图把登机站台标为aeroquay。

entries.en: The historical sensory glossary includes aeroscepsin.
entries.zh: 历史感觉词汇表中列有气流感觉这一旧名。

entries.en: An aeroshed stands at the edge of the old airfield in the photograph.
entries.zh: 照片中，旧机场边缘有一座飞机库。

entries.en: The family spent Saturday at an air show.
entries.zh: 一家人星期六去看了航空展。

entries.meaningZh: Aerosimplex：旧航空摄影测图仪名称
entries.en: The photogrammetry archive holds an Aerosimplex manual.
entries.zh: 摄影测量档案保存着一本Aerosimplex测图仪手册。

entries.meaningZh: aerosol-ether-xylene：原资料中的复合化学标签
entries.en: The archive records the label aerosol-ether-xylene exactly as printed.
entries.zh: 档案按原印刷形式记录了aerosol-ether-xylene这一标签。

entries.meaningZh: aerosoloscope：空气微粒测量器的旧名称
entries.en: The instrument catalogue has a section headed aerosoloscope.
entries.zh: 仪器目录有一个以空气微粒测量器为标题的部分。

entries.en: The report surveys employment in the aerospace industry.
entries.zh: 报告调查了航空航天工业的就业情况。

entries.en: The agricultural-history display includes a photograph of an aerosprayer.
entries.zh: 农业史展陈中有一张航空喷雾装置的照片。

entries.en: The mapping project combined aerosurveying with ground observations.
entries.zh: 制图项目结合了航空勘测与地面观察。

entries.meaningZh: Aerotex：原资料中的材料商品名
entries.en: The old materials catalogue prints Aerotex in the product-name column.
entries.zh: 旧材料目录把Aerotex印在产品名称一栏。

entries.en: The medical historian treats aerotherapy as a historical approach to care.
entries.zh: 医学史研究者把空气疗法视为一种历史照护方式。

entries.en: The lecture introduced an aerothermodynamic model of the flow.
entries.zh: 讲课介绍了一个关于流动的气动热力学模型。

entries.en: The museum caption identifies the apparatus with the old term aerothermotherapy.
entries.zh: 博物馆说明牌用热空气疗法这一旧名标识该装置。

entries.meaningZh: aerotonometer：气体张力测定器的旧名称
entries.en: The instrument archive includes an aerotonometer.
entries.zh: 仪器档案中有一台气体张力测定器。

entries.en: The transport exhibition displayed a model of an aerotrain.
entries.zh: 交通展览展出了一辆气垫列车模型。

entries.en: The surveying-history display includes an aerotriangulator.
entries.zh: 测绘史展陈中有一台空中三角测量仪。

entries.en: The engineering drawing labels the turbine unit aeroturbine.
entries.zh: 工程图把涡轮单元标为航空涡轮。

entries.en: The photogrammetry catalogue includes an Aerovelex instrument.
entries.zh: 摄影测量目录中有一台Aerovelex测图仪。

entries.en: The historical propellant table lists Aerozine by its trade name.
entries.zh: 历史推进剂表按商品名列出航空肼。

entries.en: The old pigment list describes aerugin as copper green.
entries.zh: 旧颜料表把aerugin描述为铜绿。

entries.en: The mineral drawer contains a specimen labelled aerugite.
entries.zh: 矿物抽屉中有一件标为块砷镍矿的标本。

entries.en: The medical glossary describes erythropsia as a red tint to vision.
entries.zh: 医学词汇表把红视症描述为视觉带红色调。

entries.meaningZh: AESC：美国工程标准委员会的历史缩写
entries.en: The archive preserves an AESC standards booklet.
entries.zh: 档案保存着一本美国工程标准委员会的标准小册子。

entries.en: The chemical-name index includes aescigenin.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引中列有七叶配基。

entries.meaningZh: AEST：澳大利亚东部标准时间
entries.en: The webinar starts at 10 a.m. AEST.
entries.zh: 网络研讨会于澳大利亚东部标准时间上午十点开始。

entries.en: The old vegetation map uses aestatisilvae for summer-green woodland.
entries.zh: 旧植被图用aestatisilvae表示夏绿林。

entries.en: The history-of-science syllabus lists aesthematology under the study of sensation.
entries.zh: 科学史大纲把感觉学列在感觉研究之下。

entries.en: The library catalogue places aesthesiology beside other works on sensation.
entries.zh: 图书馆目录把感觉学与其他感觉研究著作编在一起。

entries.meaningZh: aestidurilignosa：夏绿硬叶木本群落的旧名称
entries.en: The vegetation scheme separates aestidurilignosa from evergreen woodland.
entries.zh: 植被分类方案把夏绿硬叶木本群落与常绿林分开。

entries.meaningZh: aestisilval：夏绿林的，旧生态学用语
entries.en: The old vegetation scheme distinguishes aestisilval woodland from evergreen forest.
entries.zh: 旧植被分类方案区分了夏绿林与常绿林。

entries.en: The chemical index lists aesculetin under its standard spelling.
entries.zh: 化学索引用标准拼写列出七叶亭。

entries.meaningZh: aetatis：拉丁语的在……岁时，常见于肖像或碑文
entries.en: The portrait inscription includes aetatis beside the sitter's age.
entries.zh: 肖像铭文在被画者年龄旁写有aetatis。

entries.meaningZh: aetherealize：使灵妙化；使空灵化，旧拼写
entries.en: The poet seems to aetherealize an ordinary landscape.
entries.zh: 诗人仿佛把寻常景色写得空灵起来。

entries.en: The surgical-history chapter explains the old verb aetherize.
entries.zh: 外科史章节解释了以乙醚麻醉这一旧动词。

entries.meaningZh: aethusin：毒欧芹相关物质的历史名称
entries.en: The historical toxicology index includes aethusin.
entries.zh: 历史毒理学索引列有aethusin。

entries.meaningZh: ethylhydrocupreine hydrochloride：盐酸乙基氢化奎宁
entries.en: The historical drug index lists ethylhydrocupreine hydrochloride under an older spelling.
entries.zh: 历史药名索引在一个较旧的拼写形式下列出盐酸乙基氢化奎宁。

entries.meaningZh: aetio-：原因或病因的构词成分
entries.en: Aetiology concerns the causes of a condition.
entries.zh: 病因学研究某种状况的成因。

entries.meaningZh: etiolation：黄化，植物在缺光等情况下的苍白细长生长
entries.en: The botany textbook illustrates etiolation with a pale seedling.
entries.zh: 植物学教材用一株苍白幼苗展示黄化现象。

entries.meaningZh: AETL：原资料中的工程试验机构名称缩写
entries.en: The archived test report carries an AETL stamp.
entries.zh: 存档试验报告上盖有AETL印章。

entries.en: The old portrait is marked aet. 36.
entries.zh: 旧肖像标着36岁这一年龄说明。

entries.meaningZh: AEY：冰岛阿库雷里机场代码
entries.en: The baggage label showed AEY as the destination code.
entries.zh: 行李标签上的目的地代码是AEY。

entries.meaningZh: AFATDS：高级野战炮兵战术数据系统
entries.en: The military-history glossary expands AFATDS in full.
entries.zh: 军事史词汇表完整展开了高级野战炮兵战术数据系统的缩写。

entries.en: The energy report uses AFBC for atmospheric fluidized-bed combustion.
entries.zh: 能源报告用AFBC表示常压流化床燃烧。

entries.en: The packaging-machine diagram labels the AFD beside the conveyor.
entries.zh: 包装机示意图在传送带旁标出了自动供料装置。

entries.meaningZh: AFDL：小型辅助浮船坞的舰船分类标记
entries.en: The naval-history catalogue lists a small dock under AFDL.
entries.zh: 海军史目录在AFDL项下列出一个小型浮船坞。

entries.en: The old pharmacy catalogue lists Afenil among trade names.
entries.zh: 旧药学目录把Afenil列在商品名中。

entries.meaningZh: affiancer：订立婚约或作出婚姻承诺的人，旧式用语
entries.en: The old legal text calls the person making the pledge an affiancer.
entries.zh: 旧法律文献把作出婚约承诺的人称为affiancer。

entries.meaningZh: affinability：砂糖洗炼能力的旧技术名称
entries.en: The sugar-industry glossary lists affinability as a refining-related property.
entries.zh: 糖业词汇表把affinability列为与洗炼有关的性质。

entries.en: The affineur checked the cheeses stored in the cool room.
entries.zh: 奶酪熟成师检查了存放在冷藏室里的奶酪。

entries.en: The historian retained affion in the transcription of the old customs list.
entries.zh: 历史学家在转录旧海关清单时保留了affion。

entries.meaningZh: affirmer：肯定或郑重确认某事的人
entries.en: The debate set an affirmer against a critic of the proposal.
entries.zh: 辩论让一位支持该提案的人与一位批评者对阵。

entries.en: The advertisement targeted young affluents with expensive tastes.
entries.zh: 广告面向品味昂贵的年轻富裕消费者。

entries.meaningZh: affordance：可供性，环境或物体提供的行动可能性
entries.en: The designer studied how the handle's shape changes its affordances.
entries.zh: 设计师研究了把手形状如何改变它提供的操作可能性。

entries.meaningZh: affrayer：参与斗殴或闹事的人，旧式法律用语
entries.en: The old court record refers to the men as affrayers.
entries.zh: 旧法庭记录把这些人称为斗殴者。

entries.meaningZh: affrighter：使人惊恐的人或事物，旧式用语
entries.en: The narrator calls the threatening figure an affrighter.
entries.zh: 叙述者把那个可怕的身影称为使人惊恐之物。

entries.en: The labour archive holds an AFGE newsletter.
entries.zh: 劳工档案收藏着一份美国政府雇员联合会简报。

entries.en: The atlas includes a map of Afghanistan's mountain ranges.
entries.zh: 地图册中有一张阿富汗山脉图。

entries.en: The textile museum labels the small tool aficot.
entries.zh: 纺织博物馆把这件小工具标为aficot。

entries.en: The forensic-science display explains the initials AFIS.
entries.zh: 法证科学展陈解释了自动指纹识别系统的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: AFL-CIO：美国劳工联合会与产业工会联合会
entries.en: The history book includes an AFL-CIO convention photograph.
entries.zh: 历史书中有一张美国劳联—产联大会照片。

entries.en: The melody resolves on A-flat.
entries.zh: 旋律在降A音上收束。

entries.meaningZh: aflood：被水淹没的，旧式或诗体用语
entries.en: The low field was aflood after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，低洼田地被水淹没了。

entries.meaningZh: AFMA：美国鞋类制造商协会的历史简称
entries.en: The footwear archive preserves an AFMA trade-show programme.
entries.zh: 鞋业档案保存着一份美国鞋类制造商协会贸易展节目册。

entries.meaningZh: à fond：彻底地；深入地，法语借入表达
entries.en: He studied the subject à fond before writing about it.
entries.zh: 他写这个课题前，对它作了深入研究。

entries.meaningZh: AFOS：现场作业与服务自动化系统名称
entries.en: The old operations manual shows an AFOS terminal.
entries.zh: 旧操作手册中画有一台AFOS终端。

entries.meaningZh: Afpol：原资料中的丁苯橡胶名称
entries.en: The materials archive labels the rubber sample Afpol.
entries.zh: 材料档案把这件橡胶样品标为Afpol。

entries.meaningZh: AFR：容许故障率的缩略标记
entries.en: The reliability table labels its allowable-failure-rate column AFR.
entries.zh: 可靠性表用AFR标记容许故障率一栏。

entries.en: The French heading uses africain to describe the regional theme.
entries.zh: 法语标题用africain说明其非洲主题。

entries.meaningZh: Africare：非洲发展援助组织名称
entries.en: The archive contains an old Africare fundraising leaflet.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份旧的Africare筹款说明页。

entries.meaningZh: Afrodite：阿佛洛狄忒的意大利语名称形式
entries.en: The Italian catalogue names the figure Afrodite.
entries.zh: 意大利语图录把这个人物称为阿佛洛狄忒。

entries.en: The fossil display includes a label for Afropithecus.
entries.zh: 化石展陈中有一个非洲古猿属标签。

entries.en: The library holds an old AFSA newsletter.
entries.zh: 图书馆收藏着一份旧美国外交人员协会简报。

entries.en: The communications glossary explains AFSK beside other modulation terms.
entries.zh: 通信词汇表在其他调制术语旁解释了音频频移键控。

entries.en: The lecture places AFTA in a discussion of regional trade arrangements.
entries.zh: 这堂课在讨论区域贸易安排时介绍了东盟自由贸易区。

entries.en: She found the interview in an old issue of Aftenposten.
entries.zh: 她在一份旧《晚邮报》中找到了那篇采访。

entries.en: The production schedule includes a stage labelled after-baking.
entries.zh: 生产日程中有一个标为后烘处理的阶段。

entries.en: The drawing shows the vessel's afterbody in profile.
entries.zh: 图纸用侧视图展示了船体后部。

entries.en: We stayed after class to finish the poster.
entries.zh: 我们下课后留下来完成海报。

entries.en: The physiology diagram labels a brief after-contraction.
entries.zh: 生理学示意图标出了一次短暂的后收缩。

entries.en: The park gates are closed after dark.
entries.zh: 公园大门在天黑后关闭。

entries.meaningZh: after-discharge：刺激终止后仍持续的放电
entries.en: The textbook distinguishes an after-discharge from the initial response.
entries.zh: 教材区分了后放电与最初反应。

entries.en: The engineering chart marks the after-expansion stage.
entries.zh: 工程图表标出了后膨胀阶段。

entries.en: The mechanic's report mentions afterfire in the exhaust.
entries.zh: 机械师的报告提到了排气系统中的后发火。

entries.en: The old process chart marks a stage called after-generation.
entries.zh: 旧流程图标出了一个称为后续生成的阶段。

entries.en: The psychology notes describe after-hearing as an auditory after-effect.
entries.zh: 心理学笔记把后音觉描述为听觉后效。

entries.en: The novel explores the characters' different beliefs about the afterlife.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了人物对来世的不同信念。

entries.en: The company supplies parts to the aftermarket.
entries.zh: 这家公司向售后市场供应零件。

entries.meaningZh: after-movement：后继运动；自发继续的动作
entries.en: The physiology diagram labels the involuntary after-movement.
entries.zh: 生理学示意图标出了不随意的后继运动。

entries.en: The foundry record lists the after-pour separately.
entries.zh: 铸造记录把后续浇注单独列出。

entries.en: The process description separates after-purification from the first stage.
entries.zh: 流程描述把后净化与第一阶段分开。

entries.en: A small aftershock rattled the windows later that evening.
entries.zh: 当天晚上稍晚，一次小余震震得窗户作响。

entries.meaningZh: after-specification：后部说明，旧计算机术语
entries.en: The old programming manual places the after-specification below the declaration.
entries.zh: 旧编程手册把后部说明放在声明之后。

entries.en: They played cards after supper.
entries.zh: 他们晚饭后打牌。

entries.meaningZh: afterthought：事后补充的想法或东西
entries.en: The apology sounded like an afterthought.
entries.zh: 这番道歉听起来像是事后才补上的。

entries.en: We walked home afterwards.
entries.zh: 之后我们步行回家。

entries.en: I decided to go after all.
entries.zh: 我最终还是决定去。

entries.meaningZh: afterburst：主事件之后的次生突发或崩落，旧技术名
entries.en: The historical geology report records an afterburst following the first collapse.
entries.zh: 历史地质报告记录了首次崩落之后的一次次生突发。

entries.en: The historical treatment record uses the verb afterchlorinate.
entries.zh: 历史处理记录使用了后续加氯这一动词。

entries.en: The materials report has a section on aftercure.
entries.zh: 材料报告有一个关于后固化的章节。

entries.en: The production log records afterdrying as a separate stage.
entries.zh: 生产日志把再干燥记为单独阶段。

entries.en: The drawing marks the afterframe at the rear of the assembly.
entries.zh: 图纸在组件后部标出了后框架。

entries.meaningZh: afterimpression：后感觉；刺激消失后延续的印象
entries.en: The psychology glossary compares an afterimpression with the original sensation.
entries.zh: 心理学词汇表比较了后感觉与原始感觉。

entries.meaningZh: afterpower：滞后功率或残余功率的旧技术名
entries.en: The historical engineering table includes a column headed afterpower.
entries.zh: 历史工程表中有一栏标题为滞后功率。

entries.en: The bell's aftersound lingered in the quiet hall.
entries.zh: 钟声的余音在安静大厅里萦绕。

entries.en: The centre offers aftercare to people returning to independent living.
entries.zh: 这个中心为重返独立生活的人提供后续支持。

entries.meaningZh: aftline：船尾纵剖线的旧制图名称
entries.en: The naval drawing labels the aftline near the stern.
entries.zh: 船舶图纸在船尾附近标出了aftline。

entries.meaningZh: aftosa：口蹄疫的外语或旧文献名称
entries.en: The historical veterinary index cross-references aftosa to foot-and-mouth disease.
entries.zh: 历史兽医学索引把aftosa交叉指向口蹄疫。

entries.en: The block diagram shows each AFU as a separate box.
entries.zh: 框图把每个独立功能单元画成单独方框。

entries.en: The military-history display includes an AFV recognition poster.
entries.zh: 军事史展陈中有一张装甲战斗车辆识别海报。

entries.en: Agnes brought a spare pair of reading glasses.
entries.zh: 艾格尼丝多带了一副老花眼镜。

entries.en: Could you read the last sentence again?
entries.zh: 你能再读一遍最后一句吗？

entries.meaningZh: against all odds：尽管困难重重；克服一切不利条件
entries.en: Against all odds, the tiny shop survived.
entries.zh: 尽管困难重重，这家小店还是生存了下来。

entries.meaningZh: againstism：习惯性反对的态度，罕见构词
entries.en: The columnist called the committee's constant refusal againstism.
entries.zh: 专栏作者把委员会一味拒绝的态度称为againstism。

entries.meaningZh: agalactosia：乳汁分泌缺乏的旧术语
entries.en: The historical medical glossary lists agalactosia among lactation terms.
entries.zh: 历史医学词汇表把agalactosia列在泌乳相关术语中。

entries.meaningZh: agalma：希腊语的雕像或供奉物，见艺术史用语
entries.en: The art historian uses agalma when discussing the small votive figure.
entries.zh: 艺术史研究者在讨论小型供奉雕像时使用了agalma。

entries.en: Two agamas rested on the same flat rock without moving.
entries.zh: 两只Agama属的蜥蜴一动不动地在同一块平坦的岩石上休息。

entries.meaningZh: agamis：agami的复数，南美洲喇叭鸟类的旧称
entries.en: The bird catalogue lists agamis among South American birds.
entries.zh: 鸟类目录把agamis列在南美洲鸟类中。

entries.en: The historical biology glossary places agamocytogony under asexual reproduction.
entries.zh: 历史生物学词汇表把无配生殖列在无性生殖之下。

entries.en: The medical vocabulary exercise includes ankyloblepharon.
entries.zh: 医学词汇练习中列有眼睑粘连。

entries.en: A box of agarbatti stood on the shelf beside the candles.
entries.zh: 一盒线香放在蜡烛旁的搁板上。

entries.meaningZh: agaricin：落叶松蕈相关物质的历史名称
entries.en: The old pharmacognosy index lists agaricin under fungal products.
entries.zh: 旧生药学索引把agaricin列在真菌产物之下。

entries.meaningZh: agarin：原资料中的伞菌碱旧名
entries.en: The historical toxicology index keeps agarin under its original name.
entries.zh: 历史毒理学索引保留了agarin的原名称。

entries.meaningZh: agaropectin：琼脂胶，琼脂中的一类多糖组分
entries.en: The polysaccharide chart distinguishes agaropectin from agarose.
entries.zh: 多糖图表区分了琼脂胶与琼脂糖。

entries.en: The pendant was carved from banded agate.
entries.zh: 吊坠由带状玛瑙雕成。

entries.en: The chemical-name index includes agavogenin among plant-related entries.
entries.zh: 化学名称索引在植物相关条目中列出了龙舌兰配基。
